newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colston applies to form party.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colston applies to form party.

text.p: The Australian Electoral Commission revealed on Wednesday that it had received an application from key independent Senator Mal Colston to register a political party.
Colston wanted to register the "Queensland First" party, the commission said in a newspaper advertisement calling for comments.
The Australian Federal Police are examining allegations that Colston misused an expense allowance and gave government-paid jobs in his office to relatives who did not work.

Colston is one of two independents in the upper house of parliament who have routinely supplied the two votes that the Liberal-National government needs to get contentious legislation through the parliament.
All other non-government senators belong to leftist parties that usually oppose the government's contentious measures.
Colston defected from the opposition Labor party in August, taking a government offer to support him as deputy Senate president.
He said at the time his votes would be guided in part by the interests of Queensland, his home state.
